# ISTQB Testing Foundation Materials

## Authority tier

Tier A

## Status

foundation

## Owner / maintainer

ISTQB

## URL

https://www.istqb.org/certifications/certified-tester-foundation-level

## Last checked

2026-06-07

## Scope

General testing vocabulary, testing roles, agile testing practices, test techniques, risk-based thinking, and foundation-level QA concepts.

## Why trusted

ISTQB is a recognized testing certification and syllabus organization.

## Caveats

Use for shared terminology and process concepts. It does not define Java framework APIs or project-specific automation design.

## Extracted rules

- Separate test objective, test condition, test data, test oracle, and expected result.
- Connect test effort to product risk and delivery context.

## Do not use this source for

JUnit, Selenium, REST Assured, or Mockito syntax.
